issue.body:
This bug is triggered by the HLO-to-StableHLO conversion: the HLO module runs successfully via `run_hlo_module --input_format=hlo`, and the conversion via `hlo-translate --hlo-to-mlir` also succeeds, but running the translated StableHLO via `run_hlo_module --input_format=stablehlo` fails with: a SIGABRT crash at `attribute_exporter.cc:86 false Mesh not found with name: @mesh`.

## Environment

- **CPU**: `Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900HX`
- **GPU**: `NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU`
- **CUDA Driver**: `580.126.09`
- **XLA commit**: `6f1f2d916dcef0428bfa7ea66765be539126c4f2`
- **StableHLO commit**: `e6f81ebd06b3509f2c7fa6175430aadbd4d724ca`

## HLO module

```
HloModule jit_matmul, entry_computation_layout={(f64[8,3]{1,0}, f64[])->f64[8,3]{1,0}}, allow_spmd_sharding_propagation_to_parameters={false,true}, allow_spmd_sharding_propagation_to_output={true}, num_partitions=2

ENTRY main.4 {
  Arg_1.2 = f64[] parameter(1)
  Arg_0.1 = f64[8,3]{1,0} parameter(0), frontend_attributes={xla.sdy.sharding="#sdy.sharding<@mesh, [{\"x\"}, {}]>"}
  ROOT dot.3 = f64[8,3]{1,0} dot(Arg_1.2, Arg_0.1), lhs_contracting_dims={}, rhs_contracting_dims={}
}
```

## Lifted StableHLO IR

```mlir
module @jit_matmul attributes {mhlo.cross_program_prefetches = [], mhlo.input_output_alias = [], mhlo.is_dynamic = false, mhlo.num_partitions = 2 : i32, mhlo.use_auto_spmd_partitioning = false} {
  func.func @main(%arg0: tensor<8x3xf64> {mhlo.frontend_attributes = {xla.sdy.sharding = "#sdy.sharding<@mesh, [{\22x\22}, {}]>"}}, %arg1: tensor<f64>) -> tensor<8x3xf64> {
    %0 = stablehlo.dot_general %arg1, %arg0, contracting_dims = [] x [], precision = [DEFAULT, DEFAULT] : (tensor<f64>, tensor<8x3xf64>) -> tensor<8x3xf64>
    return %0 : tensor<8x3xf64>
  }
}
```

## Reproduction (StableHLO run on CPU — failed (rc=-6, SIGABRT))

**Command:**

```bash
run_hlo_module \
  --platform=CPU \
  --reference_platform= \
  --input_format=stablehlo \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_645.mlir
```

**Output:**

```
WARNING: All log messages before absl::InitializeLog() is called are written to STDERR
F0000 00:00:1786851597.125379 3938496 attribute_exporter.cc:86] Check failed: false Mesh not found with name: @mesh
*** Check failure stack trace: ***

    @     0x5b29e9ed8396  absl::lts_20260107::log_internal::LogMessage::Flush()
    @     0x5b29e2233b15  std::_Function_handler<>::_M_invoke()
    @     0x5b29e24028c7  xla::sdy::convertToHloSharding()
    @     0x5b29e223185f  xla::(anonymous namespace)::CreateOpShardingFromSdySharding()
    @     0x5b29e22317e1  xla::ExtractShardyArgShardingFromFrontendAttrs()
    @     0x5b29e210e380  mlir::(anonymous namespace)::ConvertToHloModule::RunOnFunction()
    @     0x5b29e2105e66  mlir::ConvertMlirHloToHlo()
    @     0x5b29e2107572  mlir::ConvertMlirHloToHloModule()
    @     0x5b29dfa2130c  xla::MlirHloToHloTextTranslateFunction()
    @     0x5b29dfa1f1c8  xla::StablehloToHloTextTranslateFunction()

    @     0x5b29dfa1c244  xla::LoadModuleFromData()

    @     0x5b29dfa07d2b  xla::RunAndCompare()

    @     0x7f3d9202a1ca  (unknown)
    @     0x7f3d9202a28b  __libc_start_main
    @     0x5b29e9f1da4a  _start

```

## Reference run (HLO run on CPU — succeeds)

**Command:**

```bash
run_hlo_module \
  --platform=CPU \
  --reference_platform= \
  --input_format=hlo \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_645.hlo
```

**Output:**

```

 ** Running jit_matmul_204e03cb_645.hlo**
Running HLO module with runner HloRunner...
WARNING: All log messages before absl::InitializeLog() is called are written to STDERR
W0000 00:00:1786851596.816578 3938298 sharding_propagation.cc:3132] GSPMD sharding propagation is going to be deprecated and not supported in the future. Please consider migrating to Shardy (https://openxla.org/shardy). For reference, Shardy is already the default partitioner in JAX.
... compiled and ran in 0.0347203s.
Skipping reference runner

```

The HLO→StableHLO conversion:

- `hlo-translate` — succeeds

**Command:**

```
export XLA_FLAGS='--xla_backend_extra_options=xla_cpu_use_multi_output_fusion --xla_enable_enzyme_comms_opt=true --xla_gpu_async_dot=true --xla_gpu_enable_cudnn_layer_norm=true --xla_gpu_enable_dus_accumulator_zero_init_elimination=true --xla_gpu_enable_latency_hiding_scheduler=true --xla_gpu_enable_scatter_determinism_expander=true --xla_gpu_experimental_stream_annotation=true --xla_gpu_experimental_use_ragged_dot_fusion --xla_gpu_gemm_rewrite_size_threshold=0 --xla_gpu_multi_streamed_windowed_einsum=true --xla_recognize_reduction_optimization_level=1 --xla_reduce_window_rewrite_base_length=1'
hlo-translate \
  --hlo-to-mlir \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_645.hlo \
  -o \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_645.mlir
```
